The '''Varvrona system''' was located in the [[Obtrexta sector/Legends|Obtrexta sector]], a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was connected via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Dolis system/Legends|Dolis]] and [[Jaemus system/Legends|Jaemus systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Varvrona [[Star system/Legends|system]] fell within the borders of the [[Pentastar Alignment]] between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and was a part of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] between [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]] and [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Varvrona system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-4.<ref name="TEA" />
